items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So Big Sid, with all the coaching of everyone in the band, we got him on the plane.

ctx.x: The band -- this was an experience, oh, boy. 'Cause I never should have got that thing. We had a tune -- I can't recall the name of it. Something about the sun, like, big preamble introduction, you know. And leave a bar out, and Big Sid would say, "Quit your squawking. I hear your talking," you know.

So, time come for us to leave the Sherman Hotel. We were going to fly to Toronto. I didn't tell you this, did I? I had to fly to Toronto. And Big Sid was afraid of airplanes. So was Vido Musso. So Vido called up long distance and told his wife to send a wire, that the immigration authorities wanted him out here. So he got in his car and drove to Toronto. He was there when we got there.

So Big Sid, with all the coaching of everyone in the band, we got him on the plane. So he gets even with the wings, where he can look out the window. We hadn't even taxied out to rev up. He saw this oil bubbling out from around the engine, he got up and went to the tail end of the plane. (laughs) So now, we get to Toronto. They're supposed to have reservations for the band. What's the name of the hotel in Toronto? King George? King Edward? James? Something.
